description: Documentation-only change: publish a complete product contract page for every supported built-in Action (inputs, outputs, error codes, and a directly usable example), fill the eight currently-undocumented Actions, reconcile the existing opencode.md and pi.md pages with their current manifests, and make the Action contract overview enumerate every supported Action without a remaining-coverage gap footnote.

tasks.title: Author contract pages for the core and OpenSpec Actions
tasks.spec: specs/action-contract-pages/spec.md#Every supported built-in Action has a product contract page, specs/action-contract-pages/spec.md#Contract pages mirror manifest declarations exactly, specs/action-contract-pages/spec.md#Each contract page includes a directly usable example
tasks.description: Create two new group pages under docs/actions/: core.md covering core/process, core/script, core/artifact-exists, and core/marker; and openspec.md covering mohist/openspec-tasks, mohist/openspec-artifacts, and mohist/archive-change. Each Action gets one level-2 section with a one-sentence purpose, an inputs table (字段 | 必填 | 默认 | 含义), an outputs table (字段 | 含义), a business error code table (错误码 | 含义), and one self-contained YAML snippet that can be pasted into a Workflow definition. Content mirrors the corresponding manifest declarations in packages/runner/src/actions/built-ins.ts without introducing or omitting any declared input, output, or error code, and platform-reserved codes (invalid-input, unexpected-error, timeout) are not listed as Action business errors.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/actions/core.md exists and contains one level-2 section per Action: core/process, core/script, core/artifact-exists, and core/marker
docs/actions/openspec.md exists and contains one level-2 section per Action: mohist/openspec-tasks, mohist/openspec-artifacts, and mohist/archive-change

Each Action section in core.md and openspec.md contains an inputs table, an outputs table, and a business error code table whose rows match the corresponding manifest entry in packages/runner/src/actions/built-ins.ts (name, accepted kinds translated to 产品语言, required status, default when declared, declared outputs, declared business error codes)

core/process documents outputs stdout and exitCode and the business error code process-failed; core/script documents outputs kind/run/shell/exitCode/stdout/stderr and business error script-failed; core/artifact-exists documents output exists and business error artifact-missing; core/marker documents the legacy alias contains of expect and business errors artifact-missing and marker-missing
mohist/openspec-tasks documents required input path, deferred input task, default items value 'tasks', output loaded, and business errors missing-source and server-unavailable
mohist/openspec-artifacts documents required input changeDir, outputs present and missing, and business error artifacts-missing
mohist/archive-change documents required input changeDir, retry-safe vs partial-archive vs missing-source vs config-error business codes, and outputs source/destination/changed/commitSha

No business error code table lists the platform-reserved codes invalid-input, unexpected-error, or timeout as Action-owned; each table is preceded by a one-sentence note attributing those codes to the platform where applicable
Every Action section ends with one YAML snippet that uses only declared inputs, binds every required input to a literal or an identified ${{ }} expression, and names any Variable it references
git diff --name-only shows additions under docs/actions/core.md and docs/actions/openspec.md only (plus this task's openspec artifacts); no source file under packages/ is modified

Manual manifest cross-check for all seven Actions against packages/runner/src/actions/built-ins.ts confirms no declared input, output, or business error code is missing and no undeclared symbol is introduced
tasks.output: docs/actions/core.md and docs/actions/openspec.md, each with full three-facet contract sections and a copy-pasteable example per Action
tasks.notes: Follow design D1 (group pages by family) and D2 (manifest is the authority; hand-written Chinese prose mirroring manifests). Translate accepted kinds to 产品语言 (string→文本, number→数值, boolean→布尔, array→数组, object→对象) while preserving YAML key symbols. Examples follow design D3 explicit-binding pattern.

tasks.title: Bring existing Git and GitHub PR group pages to the full three-facet contract shape

tasks.description: Expand docs/actions/git.md and docs/actions/github-pr.md beyond input-only listings so every Action on those pages exposes its declared outputs, business error codes, and one self-contained YAML example, matching the three-facet shape used by opencode.md and pi.md. acceptanceCriteria: docs/actions/git.md contains a level-2 section for each of mohist/workspace-prepare, mohist/rebase, mohist/rebase-status, mohist/merge-ready, and mohist/push, each with an inputs table, an outputs table, and a business error code table

mohist/rebase documents outputs such as rebasedOntoSha, beforeHeadSha, afterHeadSha, squashed, conflicts, rebased, and the seven business error codes (abort-failed, fetch-failed, base-resolve-failed, prepare-failed, rebase-failed, conflict, squash-failed)
mohist/push documents outputs refspec, landedCommit, pushed, force, forceWithLease and business errors base-moved and push-failed

mohist/workspace-prepare documents the workspace-setup business error and outputs head, residual, porcelain; mohist/merge-ready documents canMerge, conflictFiles, checkedAt, and merge-not-ready; mohist/rebase-status documents rebaseInProgress, conflicts, baseSha, headSha, mergeBaseSha, and rebase-incomplete

docs/actions/github-pr.md contains a level-2 section for each of mohist/create-github-pr, mohist/mark-github-pr-ready, mohist/merge-github-pr, mohist/github-pr-status, and the previously missing mohist/github-pr-checks

mohist/create-github-pr documents default draft=true, titleFrom/bodyFrom defaults, outputs prNumber/prUrl/operation/draft, and business errors config-error, protection-conflict, base-moved, pr-state-conflict, retry-safe, create-pr-failed
mohist/merge-github-pr documents method default 'squash', pr-checks-unavailable and pr-checks-failed business errors, and outputs mergeCommitSha/method
mohist/github-pr-checks documents required inputs repositoryUrl and prNumber, outputs pollIntervalMs/message, and business errors config-error, pr-checks-unavailable, pr-checks-failed, aborted

mohist/mark-github-pr-ready documents transitioned/previousState/state outputs and the mark-ready-failed business error; mohist/github-pr-status documents default expect='open,ready', missing token output, and pr-status-failed business error

Each Action section ends with one self-contained YAML snippet using only declared inputs; delivery examples bind repositoryUrl, source, target, remote, and prNumber through identified ${{ }} expressions and never rely on implicit Variable fallback
No business error code table lists invalid-input, unexpected-error, or timeout as Action-owned; each table is preceded by the platform-codes attribution note where applicable
git diff --name-only shows modifications to docs/actions/git.md and docs/actions/github-pr.md only (plus this task's openspec artifacts); no source file under packages/ is modified

Manual manifest cross-check for all ten Git and GitHub PR Actions against packages/runner/src/actions/built-ins.ts confirms no declared input, output, or business error code is missing and no undeclared symbol is introduced
tasks.output: Expanded docs/actions/git.md and docs/actions/github-pr.md with three-facet sections and a copy-pasteable example per Action, including the new mohist/github-pr-checks section
tasks.notes: Independent of T-001 and T-003 (different files). Follows design D1 (keep existing group pages) and D2 (manifest is the authority). Examples use the post-#445 explicit-binding pattern already proven in mohist/github-pr. The mohist/github-pr-checks section is net-new content on github-pr.md, not a separate page.
